summary: Batch Git ancestry and scope reads in activity and overlap checks

delivery.outcome: Batch and revalidate Git tree and ancestry reads in ActivityReadBatch and skip out-of-scope repository ticket scans under --identity-of.
nonGoals: Do not weaken workspace-wide checkout discovery, broken-checkout fail-closed reporting, or ActivityReadBatch TOCTOU invalidation.
Do not modify consumer adopter checkouts directly outside pinned upgrades.

architecture.decision: Route delivery_landed tree checks through _git('ls-tree', '--name-only', ...) and cache/revalidate _ancestor and parsed ticket-branch maps inside ActivityReadBatch; narrow inspect_checkout scope reads to matching identities when only_identity is set while keeping hub and bundled ticket_activity.py identical.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded commit through the protected publication process.

validation.evidence: Git-ancestry batch resolution matches standalone resolution in <= 20 subprocesses across 40 tickets and revalidates cached tree/ancestry reads on exit; bundled ticket_activity.py matches scripts/ticket_activity.py.
Identity-scoped overlap audits preserve full checkout inventory while inspecting ticket scopes only for matching repository identities.
Managed governance and Wellman conformance checks pass.
